name: Victor Negrescu, Niclas Herbst-Motion for a resolution (text as a whole)
title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the European Union's budget for 2025. It rejects cuts made by the Council of the European Union, the body of national ministers, and asks to restore and add money for research, transport, health, education, culture, farmers, fisheries, humanitarian aid, border management, defence and security. It also wants borrowing costs for the joint recovery fund paid without taking money from programmes, and more money for the Parliament's own running costs and those of other institutions.

- **What changes:** Parliament proposes adding money to many programmes and undoing the Council's cuts; nothing is final yet.
- **Who it affects:** Students, researchers, farmers, fishers, patients, regions, businesses, and people in need of aid.
- **What happens next:** Parliament and the Council negotiate to agree a final 2025 budget by 18 November 2024.
